appearance.roughnessLook: diffuse and physically plausible; neither plastic-smooth nor coarse rustic
appearance.crossViewConsistency: one continuous facade system across every exterior facade and every view

prohibitedAppearance: different plaster systems or texture scales between views

immutableVisualMaterialRules: All House A exterior facade surfaces must appear as the same continuous light rendered/plastered facade system.
Variation may come only from perspective, natural light, shadow, weathering or ambient occlusion, and minor realistic surface variation.
No image edit or render may change canonical geometry, openings, room map, site plan, roof, camera or approved visible interior composition.
An AI image is always a derived representation and can never alter this material specification or canonical geometry.

sourceOfTruth.a01SupersededAuthority: The original A01 exposed-brick material is superseded; the original remains a historical visual reference. Canonical specifications remain authoritative over pixels.

historicSupersession.reason: AI masonry used stacked/grid joints; precise object editing was unstable; deterministic texture projection produced offset geometry but a flat, skewed and visually artificial facade; a human decision changed House A to a light rendered facade.

photorealisticReference.approvalScope: facade tone, finish and texture; photographic style; lighting; black roof, openings and drainage; natural garden character; overall House A hero expression
